## [3.23.3](https://github.com/sidorares/node-mysql2/compare/

- Improved docs and readme.
- For .Net 7 and above. Adding new LevenshteinValue ref struct. This gives the developer more control over memory allocation and improves support for Span`s.
- Altered parameter names of AutoCompleteLevenshtein.Distance value1->prefix and value2->candidate
- Altered the structure of Benchmarks to make them easier to run, more consistent and understandable
- Removing Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub as it now included in the .Net SDK

## MAGI v1.8.0

AI-powered Melee coaching from your Slippi replays.

### Downloads
- **Windows:** `.exe` installer
- **macOS:** `.dmg` disk image
- **Linux:** `.AppImage` (make executable with `chmod +x`)

### Getting Started
1. Open the app
2. Go to Settings — enter your tag, browse to your replay folder
3. Click Import All
4. Go to Coaching tab and click any game for AI analysis
